messages:
maria gonzalez: FYI nightly eval flagged a spike after prompt rewrite v9. hallucination up ~6% on pset-inventory. seeing entity swaps where product names are invented. :eyes:

sanjay rao: link to the nightly run? thread_ts?

maria gonzalez: https://redwood-ci/runs/17688 (snippet below)

eval-bot: nightly-eval v2 - pset-inventory - delta +6.2% hallucination, overall acc -1.1%

maria gonzalez: failing examples (from run):
```
Q: What's the warranty for AcmeFlux 3000?
A: 5 years (NOTE: model invented 'AcmeFlux 3000', should be 'Flux 3000')
```

dina lee: that's odd — prompt rewrite swapped example order and added a paraphrase of product mentions. can you paste the prompt diff?

maria gonzalez: diff: removed anchor example that disambiguated manufacturer. gist: https://g.../diff

sanjay rao: likely prompt ordering caused model to prefer hallucinated entity fill-in. Could be context window interaction. can we run the canary with old ordering + new paraphrase to isolate?

will cole: +1 to canary. If it's a prompt-induced regression we should avoid rebaseline until we prove it's not model-side.

eval-bot: canary-run triggered: model=redwood-open-12b, prompt=pset-inventory-v9-canary, samples=500

maria gonzalez: canary results (prelim): hallucination +0.9% vs baseline, much lower than nightly which was +6.2%

dina lee: that suggests rollout combined with traffic sampling or longer prompts in nightly harness. did the nightly use longer context / debug tokens?

maria gonzalez: nightly used max_context=512; canary used 256. also we noticed different tokenization of product names due to whitespace normalization in rewrite.

sanjay rao: action items: (1) rerun nightly with max_context=256 to confirm, (2) run tokenization diff on offending examples, (3) make a tiny prompt patch reintroducing explicit anchor. who's owning?

maria gonzalez: I'll take (1) & (2). @dina take (3)?

dina lee: ok I'll craft a minimal anchor and run quick eval.

will cole: if anchor fixes, propose we do a targeted patch rollout and not a full rebaseline. also record this in the prompt audit board.

maria gonzalez: recorded: https://redwood-docs/prompt-audit/1768881234

eval-bot: rerun complete: nightly with ctx=256 -> hallucination delta +1.0% (compared to baseline). tokenization-diff: product name tokens changed from ['Flux','3000'] -> ['Flux3000'] due to regex.

maria gonzalez: bingo — regex in rewrite collapsed whitespace. That's the cause. I'll revert that regex and push a canary patch.

sanjay rao: can you include a unit test for whitespace token preservation? add a check in promptpack CI.

maria gonzalez: will do. PR: https://github.com/redwood/promptpack/pull/789

dina lee: ran anchor patch canary: hallucination -0.7% vs baseline, no perf regressions. recommend targeted patch deploy to prod prompts and open PR to rebaseline only if other diffs emerge.

will cole: approved for targeted patch. +1 from infra and ml-safety.

maria gonzalez: deploying patch to canary channels now. will update when prod deploy scheduled. :rocket:

sanjay rao: nice catch. closing for now but keep an eye on nightly noise for few cycles.

maria gonzalez: thanks team. I'll add notes to the prompt changelog and mark as resolved once prod green.

eval-bot: thread closed (automation) - resolved tag added.
